title: Application Understanding & Risk-Based Test Planning
root_cause: buildAppUnderstanding() ran post-exploration in runAutonomyPipeline (triggered by finish_qa_report). The agent explored blind — per-turn buildQaContext() was completely static with no purpose, features, risk, or knowledge. No risk model existed. Priorities were static text set once at mission start.
files_created: server/riskModel.js (420 lines) — explainable risk assessment + coverage/gap report
files_modified: server/prompt.js — testContext + adaptiveGuidance + urgencyNote injected per-turn
server/qaTools.js — adaptive priority update on report_finding
server/index.js — buildPreUnderstanding at mission start, buildCoverageReport at finalize, imports

step0_audit.title: Read-only audit
key_findings: App understanding built post-exploration in runAutonomyPipeline, never reached agent
buildQaContext() completely static — no purpose, features, risk, or knowledge
Priorities static text set once, no adaptation during execution
LLM purpose detection existed but never connected to autonomous path

step2_llm_path.title: LLM understanding path verification
step2_llm_path.status: WAS NOT CONNECTED → NOW CONNECTED via buildPreUnderstanding

evidence.llm_enhanced_in_server: Server logs show llm=true for all missions
evidence.fallback_works: useLLM=false produces same purpose with heuristic-only
evidence.architecture: Observed → Heuristic → LLM Enhancement (optional) → Application Model → Risk Assessment

step4_evidence_backed.title: Evidence-backed understanding
step4_evidence_backed.example: Purpose=crm because context keywords match; 5 features derived from PURPOSE_CATALOG + context; 12 knowledge patterns matched

step6_test_priority.title: Test priority generation
step6_test_priority.mechanism: Risk-based priorities formatted as prompt section with Priority 1-N, each with reasons and test guidance

step7_combined_context.title: Knowledge + Understanding + Risk combined
step7_combined_context.flow: Mission context → detectAppMetadata → queryKnowledge + deriveContextFeatures + PURPOSE_CATALOG → buildPreUnderstanding → risk assessment → prompt injection

step8_adaptive_priority.title: Adaptive priority during execution
step8_adaptive_priority.mechanism: report_finding → reassessRiskWithFindings → updates session.testContext.adaptiveGuidance → visible in next turn's buildQaContext

step9_coverage_gap.title: Coverage/gap detection
step9_coverage_gap.mechanism: buildCoverageReport in riskModel.js — uses capturedSteps, activities, findings to identify tested vs untested high-risk areas
step9_coverage_gap.example: Mission 4beb4c0f: tested=[contact,data,form,forms], untested_high_risk=[Pipeline or deal tracking]

step11_comparison.title: Comparison test (basic vs enhanced)

mission_b_enhanced.name: ContactVault CRM — Auth & Contact Management Test

step11_comparison.measurable_difference: Mission A got 0 risk priorities (unknown app). Mission B got 5 prioritized risk areas. Mission B tested CRM-specific features (contacts, auth) as first priority. Mission A tested generically.
step11_comparison.note: Both found the same number of findings — the app has clear bugs. The difference is in WHERE the agent started testing: enhanced mission targeted CRM risk areas first.
